item.title: BN Prose: A Beachside Conversation Amara Nnaji
item.description: Generated Image “Eiss Hanty, why are you sitting on the beach sand playing with shingles?” “How is that your business now, Madam Lantana?” I responded. “Ah, I care for you na.” “Sorry oo. Madam-carer, just let me be,” I grunted, picking up pebbles and tossing them back into the water. “No, seriously, I care about you. You left home claiming to go to your Alternative Therapist, yet look at you sitting by the beach playing with sand like a kindergartener,” Lantana said. “Lantana, please, do you mind? I really need my space right now.” “Abeg shift joor! Aunty lone-ranger. Every time you need your space, you need your space; you no dey tire of yourself?” “No, ma. I am still my best company.” “Very boring. How a human being can stay alone and claim that they are having fun by themself baffles me.” Lantana sits beside me and nudges closer. I side-eye her and shift aside. She moves closer. I sidle away; she comes closer and drapes her right leg across mine with a twinkle in her eyes. “Babe, free me na. I came here to breathe.” I begged. “You came here to breathe? Egbami, you been dey suffocate before? You left home to go to Iwona’s for therapy, so how did you now end up at the beach? “She say she get another customer.” I picked up a smooth pebble and a coral and lay back on the sand. “I no understand. She get another customer bi bawo? Didn’t you book this slot?” “I did.” “So, which kain talk be that?” Lantana was bristling already. “I was running late and sent her a message.” “You were running late? You ran from your house to here across three postcodes? With which strength abi you wan kpai?” Lantana looked worried. “Gaskiya, Lantana, you no get sense. Run as in how na? Shey today ma pack run ni? I say I come late.” “Aha! That is what you should say na, auntie. You know you runners, once you say run, we take it literally.” “So, I go run the 22 miles because I want to prove what?” I glared at her. “Ah, a le so! We never can tell with weirdos like you.” She shot me a sly grin. “Lantana, I can’t deal right now. Just free me; let me breathe.” “So you came late? How many minutes late?” “26 minutes.” “Haba, that is so unlike you. What happened?” “I tried to catch the 3:15 bus but missed it. Then walked 15 minutes to the next bus stop, and the bus was delayed for 10 minutes. I decided to walk to the next one so I could catch a direct bus to her place, but that bus stop was closed. I went to the next one.” “Johnny Walka. Why didn’t you simply take a cab? See as you punish yourself on top £20.” “I no bi God na. I no see say na so e go bẹ.” I stood up, stretched and began walking into the waters. “Babe, you wan jump inside water? No koba mẹ o,” she screeched. “Olódò ni e. Jump say wetin happen? Say she save money wey I for pay the therapist?” “Wow, that is awesome. Look how you reframed it already. item.title: Bichi assures APC of Tinubu, Yusuf’s victory in 2027
item.description: By Hadiza Yusuf The Chairman of the House of Representatives Committee on Appropriations, Abubakar Kabir Bichi, has expressed confidence that the All Progressives Congress (APC) will secure victory for President Bola Tinubu and Kano State Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf in the 2027 general elections. Bichi made the declaration on Sunday during a strategic meeting with APC members of the Kano State House of Assembly and 40 party candidates at his office in Bichi Local Government Area of the state. The lawmaker, who represents Bichi Federal Constituency, said the meeting was convened to strengthen cooperation among party members and develop strategies for the forthcoming elections. “I brought together APC members of the State House of Assembly and 40 candidates to discuss campaign strategies and coordinate our efforts towards securing victory for President Tinubu, Governor Yusuf and the party in the 2027 general elections,” he said. Bichi thanked the Speaker of the Kano State House of Assembly, Jibril Ismail Falgore, and other participants for attending the meeting. “I appreciate the Speaker and all members for honouring the invitation. Unity is our strength, and together we will deliver victory, Insha Allah,” he said. The post Bichi assures APC of Tinubu, Yusuf’s victory in 2027 appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Vikings, Chiefs and Cowboys beaten - NFL week eight
item.description: The Minnesota Vikings became the last NFL team to lose their unbeaten record as the 2026 season continued with a wild weekend. There were a number of rare occurrences during week eight while two games were settled in overtime. The Dallas Cowboys and the Kansas City Chiefs were both beaten after being stunned by late fightbacks while quarterback Joe Burrow was involved in six touchdowns as the Cincinnati Bengals won again. Otherwise running backs shone on Sunday, especially for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers as they managed to claim victory without completing a single pass. And the Baltimore Ravens lost not one but two quarterbacks during their defeat by the Buffalo Bills, including the league's two-time Most Valuable Player, Lamar Jackson. Here are the top stories from Sunday's action in the NFL. Jackson returns - but immediately injured again Lamar Jackson sustained his latest injury when his hand struck an opponent after throwing the ball [Getty Images] Two former MVPs went head-to-head as Lamar Jackson returned from three games out with an ankle injury to face Josh Allen's Buffalo Bills. But that match-up was ruined within moments as Jackson injured his right thumb on the game's first snap, and his back-up Tyler Huntley was then ruled out in the second quarter with a toe injury. That meant they had to finish the game with undrafted rookie Joe Fagnano at quarterback and Buffalo ran out comfortable 36-10 winners. The Ravens have lost their past three games and now have a 4-4 record, and Jackson could miss the rest of the season as he is set to undergo surgery. This is the latest injury blow for Jackson. Although he is one of the most gifted players of his generation, the 29-year-old seems destined not to reach the Super Bowl during his career and the Ravens could miss out on the play-offs for a second straight year. Huntley could also be out for weeks so the Ravens will have to act fast to bring in an experienced QB or Fagnano will have to start against the Jacksonville Jaguars on Thursday. NFL's Campbell taken to hospital with neck injury Broncos replace Chiefs in top spot Minnesota put their 6-0 record on the line at their NFC North rivals the Detroit Lions, who won 19-15 to halt the Vikings' unbeaten start. Jahmyr Gibbs ran for 153 yards and a touchdown as Detroit (5-2) prevailed in one of several key divisional match-ups. Lions linebacker Jack Campbell was taken to hospital to be treated for a neck injury suffered while tackling tight end TJ Hockenson in the fourth quarter. The Denver Broncos (6-2) replaced the Kansas City Chiefs (5-2) at the top of the AFC West after coming from 11 points down in the final quarter to win 28-24. Patrick Mahomes threw for three touchdowns and 321 yards but that was not enough for the Chiefs as the Broncos' defence made a goal-line stand at the death to clinch victory. The Jacksonville Jaguars (5-2) are in charge of the AFC South after romping to a 42-7 win over the Indianapolis Colts, who look set for a rebuild. Af

item.title: A world champion but 'one of us' - a city's pride in Antonelli
item.description: Manuel Fantini's eyes are wide with excitement. There's a broad grin on his face. Fantini is recalling the first time he saw Kimi Antonelli behind the wheel of a car - well, a go-kart. "When I first saw him, I said: 'Mamma mia, chi diavolo è questo?' In English that means, 'Oh Mama, who the hell is this one?'" "He was six years old. When you go to the track for the first time, it's normal you go too fast and take turns the wrong way. "But he was improving with each lap, like he'd known the track for years. At the end of that day, he was faster than the others and with a kart slower than them. Absurd! Incredible!" Fantini is speaking to BBC Sport in a small cafe in Forli, Bologna. The autumnal sun creates a glare as the light bounces off the sign of the adjacent racetrack - Galliano Park. Owned by the Fantini family for almost 30 years, it's where Antonelli first climbed into a go-kart. It had to be adapted because he wasn't tall enough to reach the throttle or brake pedals. "His priority was being better - not being faster," says Fantini. "That is the key in motorsport to be a champion. "Everyone thinks you must be fast, but the approach of Kimi is the correct approach. "He had something immediately in his veins that was not normal. If you're only fast, you can hurt yourself or make mistakes." A former racer himself, Fantini says he is proud to have been a small part in Antonelli's journey to becoming Formula 1's youngest world champion. He is sure the 20-year-old's achievement will lift the whole country - but even more so the people of Bologna, where Antonelli was born and still visits regularly. "I am very proud of him," says Fantini. "And I'm very proud of his parents because the most difficult thing nowadays is when you have so much talent, to keep the kid safe and with humility. "I see the same incredible person. He is so natural, so funny and good as a kid. But when he puts on the helmet… pay attention." Antonelli - the boy 'born in a garage' who started driving on dad's lap Kimi Antonelli with Bologna restaurant owners Roberto and Luca Bugamelli [BBC] It has been 73 years since Italy had a Formula 1 drivers' champion. For a country synonymous with speed, it's been a torturous experience. Perhaps the highlight of Antonelli's season was winning the Italian Grand Prix from 19th on the grid - showing the mastery and bravery many predict will mean he dominates the sport for years to come. After victory at Monza, Antonelli was pictured eating pasta out of his winner's trophy. The dish - tagliatelle al ragu - was a nod to his Bolognese roots and a region famed for its cuisine. About an hour from Forli is Bologna's city centre. Down a side street is Trattoria dal Biassanot - a restaurant in which Antonelli regularly dines. You might think its walls would be littered with photos of his visits, but there is not a single one. Owner Luca Bugamelli explains: "Kimi is just one of us. We've known Kimi since he was a child. He comes here with his father,

item.title: Steelers’ Jaylen Warren Reacts to His Unforgettable Birthday Against The Browns
item.description: Jaylen Warren and the Pittsburgh Steelers got their revenge on the Cleveland Browns , and they did it on the same day as the running back’s birthday. Warren turned 28 years old on Sunday, and he celebrated it with a performance to remember for a long time. The former Oklahoma State Cowboys star running back tied a career high with 143 rushing yards and a touchdown on just 17 carries. That checks out for an incredibly efficient average of 8.4 yards per carry in a 27-6 win over Cleveland at Acrisure Stadium in Pittsburgh. Birthday Celebrant Warren Speaks Up on His Big Performance in Steelers’ Win Over The Browns Nov 1, 2026; Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, USA; Pittsburgh Steelers running back Jaylen Warren (30) reacts after scoring a touchdown during the third quarter of an NFL game against the Cleveland Browns at Acrisure Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Barry Reeger-Imagn Images In a postgame interview with CBS Sports , Warren talked about the game that he just had. “Man, just run through anybody in my way. We knew it was going to be a gritty game coming in, and so that’s what we expected. And we just came in and executed,” Warren said. Warren also praised the chemistry of the team, particularly between the running backs and the offensive line. “We’re all on the same page. And there’s no little tweak that nobody else doesn’t understand. We’re all on the same page, seeing eye to eye to everything. And that’s why we put up the numbers we put up today,” added Warren, who is in his fifth season in the NFL. Moreover, Warren credited the work done by Pittsburgh’s stop unit against Cleveland. “Best defense in the nation. I wouldn’t want to have any other defense. We hype each other up. It’s reciprocated, and that’s what matters, and that’s what makes us great,” continued Warren. Pittsburgh had the Browns’ attack in a chokehold, as the Steelers avenged their loss to Cleveland earlier in the season . Deshaun Watson passed for 324 yards, but he never found the end zone. He was also sacked eight times for a loss of 41 yards. Warren can further celebrate his birthday in the coming days, as Pittsburgh now get to enjoy a much-deserved bye before hitting the field again in Week 10 versus the Cincinnati Bengals on the road. Oct 11, 2026; Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, USA; A Pittsburgh Steelers helmet sits on the field before the game against the Indianapolis Colts at Acrisure Stadium. item.title: Who should be Maryland football’s next head coach? Survey results & discussion board
item.description: COLLEGE PARK, MARYLAND - DECEMBER 13: Maryland Terrapins Athletic Director Jim Smith looks on during the game against the Michigan Wolverines at Xfinity Center on December 13, 2025 in College Park, Maryland. (Photo by G Fiume/Getty Images) | Getty Images Maryland football’s 20-17 defeat to Illinois underscored that the program’s postseason outlook is not going to be defined by the results on the field. The Terps have four more weeks to figure out who will succeed Mike Locksley as the head coach of the program. Current interim Aazaar Abdul-Rahim remains in the mix for the permanent job, but it seems almost certain that athletic director Jim Smith will look outside the organization for the answer. Terps fans who responded to our Testudo Times Reacts survey largely favored current Wake Forest head coach Jake Dickert, who signed a long-term contract at the school in December 2025 and has led the Deacons to a 7-1 start to the season. The current favorite on sports betting site Kalshi, Dan Mullen, was the least attractive option of the bunch, pulling in just 7% of the vote. Who do you think should be the next person to take charge of the Terps? This is your open space to discuss all things related to the Maryland coaching search. Keep things respectful as always.

item.title: Antonelli proves doubters wrong as he becomes F1's youngest champion
item.description: FILE PHOTO - Italian Formula One driver Andrea Kimi Antonelli of team Mercedes celebrates with champagne on the podium after winning the Italian Grand Prix at the Autodromo Nazionale Monza in Italy. (is associated with: «Antonelli proves doubters wrong as he becomes F1's youngest champion») Bradley Collyer/PA Wire/dpa After Kimi Antonelli completed his debut Formula One season at the end of 2025, he wasn't exactly seen Mercedes' safest bet for a first drivers' title since 2020 - when Lewis Hamilton sealed a record-equalling seventh championship. The Italian claimed his first three podiums, but failed to score in 10 races and Mercedes faced calls to replace the young driver, having promoted him after just three seasons in junior single-seaters. "He wins the junior formula, then a difficult year in Formula Two and that's already where people started to doubt. People were doubters," Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff said. "People said he shouldn't even be in F1, he should be at a smaller team, 10 races and no points," Wolff added, recalling that two sponsors left the team "because who is this kid?" But on Sunday at the Mexican Grand Prix, Antonelli proved all the doubters wrong and completed a remarkable turnaround from his debut campaign to claim his maiden world title and become F1's youngest-ever champion. The race was won by Max Verstappen of Red Bull, but third place was enough for Antonelli, who needed to finish at least ninth to wrap up the championship - which became a matter of a time following such a dominant year with nine victories in 19 races so far. "Very early on, we had such a strong car, and we were very consistent and put in the performance. I thought that we could have had a shot this year, and I'm really happy that we managed to clinch it all," the newly-crowned world champion said. "It's starting to get real, and I'm going to enjoy every bit of it. I'm going to go all out with my family, friends, and the team. And we're just going to enjoy it all the way, because this is a very special moment, one that we'll remember forever." Monza: From practice nightmare to epic win Before becoming a full-time Mercedes driver, Antonelli made his first practice debut on home soil: at the 2024 Italian Grand Prix in Monza. It ended after 10 minutes following a thumping crash into the barriers at the Albareto turn. But the track where many started raising eyebrows, was where Antonelli showed an epic display of talent this year and made it clear he wasn't just a kid with a dream, but a driver with the necessary tools to win a world championship. He delivered an epic recovery from 19th to first to win this season's race in Monza - becoming the first Italian to win at the Temple of Speed since 1966. His maiden F1 title also marked the first time an Italian was crowned world champion since Alberto Ascari in 1953. "Step by step he makes himself stronger and stronger and stronger, and this is the result," Antonelli's father, Marco, said after Sunday's

item.title: Hibs toast win over Hearts - but will they kick on before cup final?
item.description: Hibs players joined their fans in a stirring rendition of Sunshine On Leith [PA Media] "I want music, I want beer." Such were Marink Reedijk's wishes, shared in an official Hibernian video from the dressing room following their historic Hampden beating of Heart of Midlothian in the Scottish League Cup semi-final. If the Hibs head coach ventured into Leith on Sunday night he would not have been short of offers for both, as he has instantly scribbled his name into the history books. His wait for a first win in charge ended at game five. As player of the match Joe Newell said afterwards: "I would have taken four losses if this was the way it clicked." There was a wee wait for Reedjik to break his Hibs duck, but that is nothing compared to the agony Hibs supporters had endured since 2006 when travelling across the M8 to face their city rivals at the national stadium. Four visits, four endings with jubilant Jambos. Until now. The sights and sounds of Sunshine on Leith being belted from the east end of the national stadium will take some time to shift, for this is a win Hibs must savour. Self-professed "ice king" Reedijk revelled in the iconic anthem but admitted it is his responsibility to make "rational decisions" and so remove himself from the "lovely atmosphere". He will know he and his players must make this moment the launchpad as they attempt to lift off the bottom of the Scottish Premiership. After he has enjoyed the tunes and pints, of course. Hibs edge Hearts in thrilling derby to reach League Cup final Giant curiosity Hibs finally liberated from the sucker punch McInnes demands more after delivering Rangers' trophy chance From 'here we go' to hardworking Hibees Who could have thought it would have played out this way? On the eve of their big trip west, Hibs had slipped - again - to the foot of the league table after Kilmarnock picked up a point at home to the 10 men of St Johnstone. A shocking place for this squad to be, but it was - temporarily - rendered meaningless 24 hours later. Given their turbulent start to the season - missing out on Europe, failing to win at home and changing managers - being backed by 19,000 supporters was something in itself. Finally, they were rewarded. Those who travelled to Warsaw last year to lose out on goal difference to Legia and returned from Gent in August with an abundance of hope only to have it dashed at Easter Road, had their moment of joy. And they rightly milked it. When Jordi Altena's deep free-kick in the 93rd minute ended in goalkeeper Raphael Sallinger's hands, the roar from the other end of Hampden shook the steps on which Hearts supporters were already hovering in search of a swift exit. Those clad in maroon - all 23,000 of them present and the many others in Gorgie - are surely the only beings unmoved by the inimitable Sunshine on Leith. Newell had his hands on his head. item.title: Robert Whittaker vs. Bogdan Guskov added to UFC Sydney
item.description: LAS VEGAS, NEVADA - JULY 11: Robert Whittaker of Australia celebrates after defeating Nikita Krylov of Russia with a technical knockout in the third round of their light heavyweight bout during UFC 329 at T-Mobile Arena on July 11, 2026 in Las Vegas, Nevada. (Photo by Ian Maule/Getty Images) | Getty Images UFC Fight Night Sydney has it’s co-main event: a five round light heavyweight battle between Australian Robert Whittaker and Bogdan Guskov. The fight was announced by the promotion on Sunday for the February 6th event which will take place in the Afterpay Arena. The previously announced main event for the card features rising Aussie star Quillan Salkilld versus French special forces fighter Benoit Saint Denis. Whittaker took to Instagram to celebrate his home country return. “Super excited to announce my fight in Sydney this February,” the 35-year-old former champion said. “I know I told a lot of people I’m doing everything I can to get there. Well, guess what? It’s happening. I haven’t fought in Sydney for like ten plus years. My middleweight debut was a long time ago at this point.” View this post on Instagram “I cannot wait. I’ll have all my friends, family, and fans there. I’m going to put on a show for you guys. It’s going to be great.” This will be Robert Whittaker’s second light heavyweight fight since moving up from middleweight. While “Bobby Knuckles” was visibly smaller than Nikita Krylov when they fought at UFC 329 in July, but that didn’t stop him from earning a third round knockout win. His opponent Bogdan Guskov also holds a win over Krylov from 2025, his last win on a four fight streak. Since then he scored a draw against Jan Blachowicz and was then lost a last-minute replacement fight against Magomed Ankalaev in the summer.

item.title: Arsenal suffered another injury issue pre-Liverpool
item.description: Arsenal suffered another injury issue pre-Liverpool Mikel Arteta has revealed that Eberechi Eze had an injury issue ahead of Sunday’s game against Liverpool, increasing the importance of Christos Tzolis’ return. Photo by Alex Grimm/Getty Images Arsenal fans were somewhat surprised to see Christos Tzolis in the starting lineup against Liverpool over the weekend, as the player was only making his first appearance in the squad after weeks out injured. But Mikel Arteta explained afterwards that part of the problem was a new injury issue for left-wing alternative option Eberechi Eze . “We had an issue with Ebs as well,” Arteta revealed . “It was incredible that he was in the squad today. I want to give credit to all the medical and the performance team because what they’re doing with those boys is incredible, every three days to keep everybody at this level. “That’s why these are the margins sometimes where you win a football match and not when you have somebody available or not.” Photo by Leonhard Simon/Getty Images As mentioned, Eze was in the squad for the match, and he spent much of the contest warming up on the sidelines, so the hope is that he’ll be back to full fitness very shortly. Then the good news with the returning Tzolis was that he came through the match without any issues, despite immediately returning to the starting lineup and playing most of the 90. He was only eventually substituted with six minutes to play. “With Christos it’s incredible,” Arteta said. “He didn’t want to come off; he wanted to complete the game. We took some risks and at that point we decided, now is enough.” Photo by Alex Pantling/Getty Images With Eze and Tzolis both available, Arsenal will have options on the left again. Ceadach O’Neill also travelled with the squad for the Liverpool game as the extra man, and he might get chances at times too. On the other side, Arsenal are a little reliant on Noni Madueke , with Bukayo Saka injured and Max Dowman suspended. Dowman will at least be available for the midweek game against Slavia Praha , as his three-game ban only applies domestically. Photo by Lewis Storey/Getty Images

item.title: ‘Not Buffalo Bills…’ – Analyst makes bold Angel Reese and Dream prediction for 2027 WNBA Finals
item.description: Photo by Heather Diehl/Getty Images One WNBA analyst is already backing the Atlanta Dream for the 2027 WNBA Finals. The Atlanta Dream had no answer for the Golden State Valkyries in Game 7 of the tightly fought 2026 WNBA Finals. The Valkyries managed to keep star forward Angel Reese in check as she was held to just eight points in the 68-63 defeat for the Dream. Despite that, one WNBA analyst believes that Reese and the Dream’s story isn’t done and backed them to win the 2027 finals. Cindy Brunson says Atlanta Dream will win 2027 WNBA Finals During the latest episode of the ‘Her Hoops Stats’ podcast, ESPN anchor Cindy Brunson explained why she sees the Dream winning the 2027 WNBA Finals. “Now they’ve had a taste. They know what it’s like. They know they’re going to have Arena behind them… They packed it, even in the middle of the day, matinee. “We’re here, 10 toes down. That whole deal of having a big that can dominate in the post might prove problematic for Golden State down the road. I really like Atlanta to use this as one of those moments,” Brunson said. She added, “We’re not gonna be the Buffalo Bills, right? We’ve been to the finals four times, and we have come up empty. I see them putting this as mission one. We’re gonna win this thing in [2027].” Brunson also took a shot at the Buffalo Bills for the franchise’s 0-4 record in the Super Bowls. As of now, the Dream have also made four WNBA Finals appearances, but have a 0-4 record. The ESPN analyst simply doesn’t see the Dream becoming the Bills of the WNBA and expects the Reese-led franchise to end its championship drought in 2027. item.title: Millions of Nigerian workers face growing social security risks, NSITF warns
item.description: By Victor Ahiuma-Young The Nigeria Social Insurance Trust Fund, NSITF, has raised the alarm over growing social security risks facing Nigerian workers, warning that the rapid transformation of the labour market through artificial intelligence, AI, automation, digital platforms and the gig economy could leave millions of workers without adequate protection. The Fund has consequently called for urgent measures to close existing social protection gaps, strengthen employer compliance and build a sustainable safety net that guarantees workers’ welfare, dignity and economic security, irrespective of their employment arrangements. The NSITF also emphasised the need for government, employers, organised labour, social security institutions and the media to work together to ensure that technological advancement and changing employment patterns do not create a new generation of economically active but inadequately protected workers. The Managing Director/Chief Executive of NSITF, Oluwaseun Faleye, raised the concerns in his keynote address at the Labour Writers’ Association of Nigeria (LAWAN) Annual Workshop, in Lagos, The address, titled Social Security and Workers’ Welfare in Nigeria’s Political Transition: Closing the Protection Gaps and Building a Sustainable Safety Net, was presented on his behalf by the Deputy General Manager, and Head of Corporate Affairs Department, Alexandra Mede. Faleye described social security as an investment in human dignity, social stability and economic resilience, insisting that its importance should not be measured merely by institutional structures, regulations, financial contributions and statistics. According to him, social security is fundamentally about protecting workers and their families against unforeseen circumstances, including workplace injuries, disabilities, occupational accidents and the sudden loss of a family’s principal breadwinner. He said, “At its heart, social security is about people. It is about the worker who suffers an injury in the course of employment. It is about the family that suddenly loses its principal breadwinner. It is about a worker whose ability to earn an income is affected by an occupational accident.” The NSITF MD/CEO warned that Nigeria’s rapidly changing world of work was creating new challenges for traditional social protection systems, particularly with the growing adoption of technology, artificial intelligence, remote work, automation and digital employment platforms. While acknowledging the opportunities associated with these developments, he expressed concern that workers operating within emerging employment arrangements might be left outside established social protection structures. He questioned how the welfare of workers engaged through digital platforms could be guaranteed and how protection could be extended to people whose employment relationships no longer follow conventional patterns. “How do we ensure that technological progress does not create a new generation of wo

item.title: Lamar Jackson’s Return Takes Ugly Turn Against Josh Allen, Bills
item.description: Lamar Jackson’s return from a high left ankle injury didn’t last very long. It was the complete opposite, as the Baltimore Ravens superstar two-way quarterback lasted just a snap in Sunday’s marquee matchup against Josh Allen and the Buffalo Bills at the new Highmark Stadium in Orchard Park, New York. Jackson had his right hand struck by Buffalo linebacker Greg Rousseau as the two-time NFL Most Valuable Player was trying to make a pass. That led to Jackson later leaving the field with a banged-up finger. Here is a look at that finger injury, as shown on the broadcast while he was leaving the field to get checked on. A closer look at Lamar Jackson's thumb injury. Oh my goodness. This is really bad pic.twitter.com/lGiBph23LT https://t.co/n4N73NtqXn — Dov Kleiman (@NFL_DovKleiman) November 1, 2026 Ravens Get Bad News on QB Front After Injuries to Lamar Jackson, Tyler Huntly in Week 8 Oct 25, 2026; Baltimore, Maryland, USA; Baltimore Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson (8) looks on during the second quarter against the Cincinnati Bengals at M&T Bank Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Tommy Gilligan-Imagn Images There was some hope among fans that Jackson would be able to shake it off and return to the game, but he is now apparently done for the remainder of the 2026 NFL season. Baltimore head coach Jesse Minter delivered the tough news following his team’s 36-10 loss to the Bills about Jackson needing surgery to address the injury, which also means a trip to the injured reserve (via Jamison Hensley of ESPN). Making things worse for Baltimore’s quarterback situation is another injury to one of its signal-callers, with backup Tyler Huntley leaving the second quarter of the Bills game with a foot injury. It remains to be seen the extent of Huntley’s injury, but if he will have to miss time, Baltimore will have to rely on third-stringer Joe Fagnano, who was also left to finish the game versus Buffalo. Fagnano went 10/21 for 91 passing yards, zero touchdowns and an interception. Baltimore is now on a three-game losing skid after starting the season with a 4-1 record. item.title: New York Jets Rookie Omar Cooper Jr. Gets Brutal Reality Check Against Raiders
item.description: New York Jets rookie Omar Cooper Jr. was among the fantasy football darlings heading into Week 8 of the 2026 NFL season. But he was barely felt on the field during Sunday’s game between the Jets and the Las Vegas Raiders at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford. Cooper, who suffered an ankle injury in Week 1 and missed four games before returning to action in Week 6, had many excited for him entering the Raiders game. After all, he had at least 100 receiving yards in each of the two games heading into the meeting with Las Vegas. He posted 103 receiving yards and a touchdown on six receptions in a Week 6 loss to the New England Patriots. He followed that up with a 115-yard effort plus a touchdown on five catches in a 28-25 loss to the Miami Dolphins in Week 7. But against the Raiders, the former Indiana Hoosiers star wide receiver didn’t catch a pass and wasn’t even targeted as New York suffered a 38-33 loss. Omar Cooper Jr. after two straight 100-yard games: 0 targets 0 catches 0 yards 0 TD 0 fantasy points pic.twitter.com/9iXJxLo3kv — Yahoo Fantasy Sports (@YahooFantasy) November 1, 2026 Fans React to Cooper’s Unproductive Outing in Jets Loss to The Raiders Sep 13, 2026; Nashville, Tennessee, USA; New York Jets wide receiver Omar Cooper Jr. (11) runs with the ball against the Tennessee Titans during the first quarter at Nissan Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Steve Roberts-Imagn Images Fans, especially fantasy football managers who had Cooper locked in on their starting lineup for Week 8, can’t believe that the first-year pro laid an egg against Las Vegas. “Of course. The week I pick him up from free agency,” said a fan on X. Another one said: “[expletive] is absolutely rigged for money. Or ratings I’m not sure which. I won’t be silent. Just saw it live sry” From a commenter: “Ghosted after Halloween. ” “Played for Fantasy and this is what happens man…Glad the Jets lost,” a social media user posted. Via a different commenter: “Terrible coaching. For him to do that the last couple weeks and not get any looks? Awful.” Said another: “From my bench to the starting lineup possibly back to the wire” There is no way but up for Cooper going forward, as it can’t be worse for him in Week 9, when the Jets take on Patrick Mahomes and the Kansas City Chiefs at Arrowhead Stadium in Kansas City. item.title: What Broncos head coach Sean Payton thinks of false start vs. Chiefs due to deafening crowd noise
item.description: Photo by Justin Edmonds/Getty Images Denver Broncos head coach Sean Payton has weighed in on the controversial false start verdict against the Kansas City Chiefs. The Broncos defeated the Chiefs 28-24 to move to 6-2 and take a lead at the top of the AFC West following a dramatic final play. Chiefs thought they had secured a late touchdown after Patrick Mahomes threw to Rashee Rice before a red flag was thrown by officials for a false start with one second on the clock. Mahomes’ wife was furious about the false start , but what did Payton make of it? READ MORE: ‘Blew it 100 ways’ – Nick Wright drops brutal take on Kansas City Chiefs’ back-to-back defeats Sean Payton says the Broncos crowd were responsible win vs Chiefs Most NFL fans won’t feel any sympathy for Mahomes and co after an incredible Broncos display, with Andy Reid even admitting that he didn’t see the call . However, Payton believes it was the supporters inside the Empower Field at Mile High stadium who were responsible for the victory. “If you could tangibly point to a crowd win, if you could tangibly point and say the false start,” Payton said. “I mean, just from a play-caller’s standpoint, the one to the six, and you’re in another zip code with plays. That was huge.” That rallying cry came despite boos from sections of the stadium in the third quarter after the Broncos were only able to manage nine yards, prompting jeers after the third down. Despite that, they were able to get over the line and Payton was able to mark his 200th career win as a head coach. Only six have managed to do it quicker (Don Shula, George Halas, Curly Lambeau, Bill Belichick and Paul Brown) and he is 12th in NFL history to complete the feat.

item.title: Russell’s Media No-Show Cost Mercedes €5,000. Wolff Calls It ‘Understandable’
item.description: George Russell skipped his media duties after Kimi Antonelli clinched the F1 title in Mexico, earning Mercedes a fine, but Toto Wolff defended him. Having qualified on the front row, it was another disaster for Mercedes’ Russell at the start of the F1 Mexico GP. He had a good initial launch, but then slowed immediately , which dropped him outside the top five. It left him distraught, and Mercedes F1 team boss Wolff had to apologize on the radio . In a bid to recover places, he made contact with Red Bull’s Isack Hadjar, which sent the Frenchman spinning. The Brit was handed a 10-second time penalty as a result. Mercedes Fined for Russell Even though he put in a solid defense against McLaren’s Lando Norris in the first stint, he was undone by the penalty as he emerged behind him after the pit stop. He finished sixth, as the F1 title went to teammate Kimi Antonelli . Russell made sure to congratulate the Italian under the podium, but then left the circuit without attending the mandatory post-race media duties. He also missed the stewards’ hearing that followed, with a team representative giving evidence by telephone. As a result, Mercedes was fined 5,000 euros . Wolff, meanwhile, defended Russell for skipping the duties. The Austrian understands the emotional state the Brit would be in after a season he has had. After how the Mexico GP start panned out, it was a race lost for him as well, on top of the F1 title loss. Photo by Sam Bloxham/LAT Images Wolff Defends Russell for Skipping Media Duties “I saw George after the race on the FIA scales,” Wolff said to the media after the F1 Mexico GP. “And obviously he’s distraught about the situation. It was a great show of sportsmanship to go and see Kimi. I have known George for such a long time, and I know for a sports person, he is going through a hard time, but he was also responsible in getting the young man into this team. “So I saw him in that. For a racing driver, this is a catastrophic moment. And maybe today the race was a little bit of a picture of his season. This was a race for him to win. We had the pace in the car. And we let him down on the first straight. The energy delivery is not what we had thought it should be. “So, I’m very much with him at the moment. I’ve been in situations where it’s very, very difficult to cope. So, him not doing the media work or leaving the track is absolutely understandable. Him staying would have actually surprised me. So that’s absolutely all,” summed up Wolff. For Russell, the chance to defend second in the F1 championship gets even tougher. He has dropped behind Max Verstappen (261) and Lewis Hamilton (259) to be fourth with 250 points. Also, Charles Leclerc (245) is only five behind. Sorry for the sh*tshow, George. https://t.co/X6O91KchQA — Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team (@MercedesAMGF1) November 1, 2026 Russell Frustrated After Mexico GP and F1 Title Loss Naturally, Russell was left frustrated not just by the F1 title loss, but also by losing the Mexico GP.

item.title: Barcelona in contact with €70m-rated top centre-back target’s camp; player open to move
item.description: Barcelona in contact with €70m-rated top centre-back target’s camp; player open to move According to journalist Sacha Tavolieri , Barcelona never really abandoned their pursuit of Inter Milan defender Alessandro Bastoni after a failed move in the summer. The Blaugrana were keen on signing the Italian international and talks were progressing well. But, ultimately, manager Hansi Flick decided not to go ahead with the deal, leading to the transfer stalling. Now, they have revived their pursuit of the centre-half, whom they consider their top target. Barcelona have continued their interest in Bastoni Despite the transfer falling through in the summer, Barcelona never ended their interest in Bastoni completely. Indeed, as per the report, the Catalans have remained in contact with the 27-year-old defender’s camp since and continue to view him as their priority target to strengthen the backline in January. During those interactions, the message that has been conveyed between the two parties is that Bastoni remains open to moving to Barcelona and that the Spotify Camp Nou would be his preferred destination if he were to leave Inter Milan. Bastoni remains open to joining Barcelona. (Photo by Marco Luzzani/Getty Images) After all, he had already agreed a long-term contract until 2031 with the La Liga champions before the move was called off in the summer. However, the report states that the Italian international would prefer to hold talks with Flick to understand the manager’s plans for him and his role in the club’s sporting project. More meetings are expected to take place between Barça and the player’s agent to further discuss the situation. Inter Milan will demand €70 million Inter Milan, for their part, would prefer to avoid selling one of their key players, whose contract stands to expire in 2028. Inter Milan will demand €70m for Bastoni. (Photo by Angel Martinez/Getty Images) As such, the Nerazzurri have already held talks with his agent and submitted a renewal proposal, although it has been deemed insufficient by the player’s camp. In case of a sale, Inter Milan are demanding a transfer fee of €70 million in order to part ways with Bastoni. The fee has not dissuaded Barcelona, who are looking at the potential sale of Alejandro Balde in January to free up space for a new centre-back signing. It will be interesting to see how the story evolves in the coming weeks, with Barcelona reviving their pursuit of Bastoni, who remains keen on making the switch.

item.title: 2027 South Side Sox Top Prospect No. 99: Caedmon Parker
item.description: Caedmon Parker pitched his way up to High-A in his first professional season. | Caedmon Parker/Instagram Caedmon Parker Right-Handed Relief Pitcher 6´4´´ 190 pounds Age: 23 2026 High Level Winston-Salem (High-A) Age relative to high level -0.2 years SSS rank among all right-handed relievers in the system 15 Overall 2026 stats (High-A/AA) 5-4 ⚾️ 30 games ⚾️ 91 2⁄3 IP ⚾️ 3.73 ERA ⚾️ 1.484 WHIP ⚾️ 105 K ⚾️ 41 BB ⚾️ 1.5 WAR The White Sox took a chance on a college arm with some untapped potential when they selected righthander Caedmon Parker in the 15th round of the 2025 MLB draft (No. 436) out of Texas Christian University. Parker had opportunities to turn pro before landing with the South Siders. After drawing draft interest out of high school in 2021, he chose to attend TCU. The Milwaukee Brewers came calling in the 11th round of the 2024 draft, but Parker opted for another season with the Horned Frogs. A year later, he was ready to trade purple for black and white. An infielder before transitioning to the mound, Parker had his college development interrupted by Tommy John surgery, which wiped out his entire sophomore season. Across three healthy seasons at TCU, he appeared in 39 games, started 23 of them and posted a 4.95 ERA over 111 innings, with 99 strikeouts and 60 walks. Not exactly numbers that jump off the page, but the White Sox saw something worth developing. The 6´4´´, 190-pound righty features a fastball that can touch 96 mph, along with an upper-70s curveball, mid-80s changeup and low-80s slider. His pitches drew interest for their movement and underlying metrics, but the results hadn’t quite caught up. The ingredients were there. Getting them to work together consistently was the next assignment. Assigned to the Arizona Complex League after signing, Parker did not pitch professionally in 2025. The 23-year-old made his debut in 2026 with Low-A Kannapolis in 2026, starting 16 of his 18 appearances. He went an impressive 5-4 with a 3.82 ERA over 75⅓ innings, striking out 86 and walking 34 before earning a July 21 promotion to High-A Winston-Salem. The move came with a change in responsibilities. Parker worked exclusively out of the bullpen for the Dash, posting a 3.31 ERA with 19 strikeouts and seven walks over 16⅓ innings. An injury sent him to the seven-day IL in early September, ending his first professional season. Between the two stops, Parker finished with a 3.73 ERA and 105 strikeouts in 91⅔ innings across 30 appearances, good for a promising 10.3 K/9 — a respectable introduction, especially for a pitcher who entered pro ball with more promise than polish. Parker heads into 2027 with a productive debut behind him and a role still worth watching. A return to Winston-Salem would make sense, with a chance to pitch his way to Double-A Birmingham. Whether that comes in the rotation or out of the bullpen, his next step is giving the White Sox a reason to keep moving him up. Full 2027 South Side Sox Top 100 White Sox Prospects Storystre

item.title: Ravens reportedly interested in trading for veteran quarterback
item.description: Charles LeClaire-USA TODAY Sports The Baltimore Ravens’ season took a devastating turn on Sunday, when star quarterback Lamar Jackson injured his throwing thumb on the first play of a 36-10 loss to the Buffalo Bills. Now, with backup Tyler Huntley also banged up, the Ravens could reportedly turn to the trade market for help. According to one report, the Ravens could be targeting a veteran quarterback to help shore up the position, but it sounds like they’ll have to be ready to spend. Ravens’ Quarterback Injuries Jackson, who had just returned from a three-game absence due to an ankle injury, was hurt when his right hand struck Bills pass rusher Greg Rousseau on a throw. He headed to the locker room and later returned to the sideline with his hand in a cast. After the game, Ravens head coach Jesse Minter confirmed that Jackson will undergo surgery and be placed on injured reserve. Asked whether the injury could end Jackson’s season, Minter said, “potentially.” “It’s tough,” Minter said. “When it happened, I think at the time, you’re just hoping that maybe it’s something small, and then I think pretty quickly kind of realized what had happened.” To make matters worse, Huntley suffered a toe injury in the second quarter, forcing undrafted rookie Joe Fagnano into his NFL debut. The UConn product went 10-of-21 for 91 yards with an interception. ‘It Won’t Be Cheap’ According to a report from Mike Florio of Pro Football Talk, the Ravens are looking into trading for Chicago Bears quarterback Tyson Bagent. “The Ravens, we’re told, may explore the possibility of acquiring Bagent,” Florio of Pro Football Talk reported . “We’re also told that it won’t be cheap to get him.” Ravens offensive coordinator Declan Doyle held the same position with the Bears last season, so he’s familiar with Bagent. Chicago also has three quarterbacks under contract, with Bagent and Case Keenum backing up starter Caleb Williams, so they could be willing to move one of them. That said, Florio warns that acquiring Bagent won’t be cheap. “That’s how it goes when a team develops an in-season need for a quarterback,” Florio wrote. “The price goes up, as reflected by the urgency of the effort to find a replacement.” We’ll have to see whether or not the Ravens make this move. The post Ravens reportedly interested in trading for veteran quarterback appeared first on The Comeback: Today’s Top Sports Stories & Reactions .

item.title: Folarin Balogun takes a first, tiny step toward moving on from a calamitous summer
item.description: Folarin Balogun scored in Monaco’s 3-1 loss to Paris FC over the weekend. Photograph: Xavier Laine/Getty Images Before this weekend, the last time Folarin Balogun scored was in the United States’ 2-0 win over Bosnia and Herzegovina at this past summer’s World Cup. In the immediate aftermath, the outlook for Balogun seemed rosy; an ascendant player who could muster a goal in tense games. At half-time against Bosnia, US fans weren’t just wondering how far his team could advance – they were sizing Balogun up against some of the world’s best strikers. But for most of the ensuing four months, Balogun has been in limbo. His breakout World Cup was overshadowed by a red card in that same game against Bosnia and Herzegovina, followed by a scandal of which he wanted no part. Just as it seemed a summer move away from Monaco could get his club career on track, he broke off a possible deadline-day move to Everton after a lengthy visit to the training grounds and a medical he felt was improperly handled. Related: Three roles and a goal: USMNT’s ‘super player’ Alex Freeman is breaking out for Villarreal While many expect that Balogun will get his move in January, to the Premier League or elsewhere, Monaco have understandably prepared for life without him. New manager Filipe Luís continues to prefer 20-year-old German youth international Paris Brunner to Balogun, giving the youngster ample time to tap into his vast potential. Balogun’s opportunities to turn the page have been limited. On Sunday, though, Balogun took the first steps toward a brighter future, scoring the lone goal as Monaco fell 3-1 to Paris FC. Monaco struggled to muster any meaningful chances in the first half against Paris, with Brunner sending the team’s only shot wide. Paris FC attacked relentlessly, stunning the early Ligue 1 title hopefuls with two goals just before half-time. On days when Brunner puts it all together, such as when he bagged a brace against Marseille, he lives up to Luis’s faith. On other days, like Sunday, that faith can backfire. Enter Balogun. Luís gave the American a chance to buck his months-long drought, bringing him on at half-time in place of Brunner, with a golden opportunity presenting itself in the 66th minute. Monaco broke up the right flank with a dribble from Brazilian right-back Vanderson, with Balogun running the channels while the Paris defense backtracked. Vanderson played a teasing low cross into the mixer that the goalkeeper couldn’t claim. Balogun needed just one prod, directing the ball to the far post. It wasn’t pretty, but it looked exceedingly comfortable, a rare return to the happy place that Balogun once frequented. Just last season, Balogun finished fourth in Ligue 1’s goalscoring charts, bagging 13 for Monaco, with another six in the Champions League and the Coupe de France. His good form continued at the World Cup, with two first-half goals in the opening rout of Paraguay. His movement forced Australia into an own goal, with the Bosnia game pro

item.title: Dino Melaye challenges Tinubu to Quranic citation contest
item.description: By Adegboyega Adeleye Former Kogi West Senator and ADC Chieftain, Dino Melaye, has challenged President Bola Tinubu to a Quranic citation contest, following the President’s ongoing spiritual visit to Saudi Arabia for Umrah, the lesser Hajj. Melaye issued the challenge in a post on his X handle on Monday, saying he was ready to compete with Tinubu in citing passages from the Quran when the President returns to Nigeria. He wrote, “Now that Alhaji Bola Tinubu is in Umrah. Immediately he comes back I challenge him to a Quanic citation competition with me. No one can mock God. SDM” Now that Alhaji Bola Tinubu is in Umrah. Immediately he comes back I challenge him to a Quanic citation competition with me. No one can mock God. SDM pic.twitter.com/lssJkwMUz6 — Senator Dino Melaye. (SDM) (@_dinomelaye) November 2, 2026 The challenge comes amid public attention surrounding Tinubu’s spiritual activities in Makkah, where he performed the Umrah pilgrimage and was granted access to pray inside the Holy Ka’abah. Vanguard reported that Tinubu arrived in Saudi Arabia on Thursday, October 29, ahead of the religious exercise, which he performed at the Grand Mosque, Masjid al-Haram, on Friday, October 30. The President was granted the rare privilege of entering the sacred structure by Saudi Arabia’s King Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques. According to the Presidency, Sheikh Dahlulah Muthawal of Masjid al-Haram led Tinubu into the Ka’abah, where he offered prayers of gratitude and sought divine guidance for Nigeria. In his reflection on the spiritual experience, Tinubu said he had prayed for wisdom and resilience to continue serving Nigerians. He also cited Surah Aal-Imran, Verse 26 of the Quran, which speaks about Allah’s ultimate authority over power and sovereignty. “There is no other God but Almighty Allah. He is the giver and the taker. He owns power and authority,” the President said. Tinubu subsequently reaffirmed his commitment to national development, saying his determination to build a prosperous Nigeria had been strengthened by the spiritual experience. The President travelled to Saudi Arabia with a delegation that included the Attorney-General of the Federation and Minister of Justice, Lateef Fagbemi; Coordinating Minister of Health and Social Welfare, Professor Muhammad Ali Pate; and governors of Borno, Sokoto, Jigawa, Kaduna, Yobe and Kwara states, among other officials and business leaders. The post Dino Melaye challenges Tinubu to Quranic citation contest appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Kimi Antonelli reveals why he won’t take number 1 for the 2027 F1 season
item.description: Motorsport photo The number 1 will not be seen on the Formula 1 grid next season for the first time since 2021. Max Verstappen and Lando Norris have consistently decided to take the opportunity to claim number 1 after winning their world titles, but Antonelli will not do so. Asked by Motorsport.com whether he would switch to number 1 or whether number 12 held such special meaning for him that he wanted to keep it, he explained after the race in Mexico: “I think I'll stay with number 12. "I'll stay with number 12 because, obviously, it's a very special number for me”, Antonelli said shortly after replacing Sebastian Vettel as the youngest world champion of all time. The number 12 is a tribute to Antonelli's idol Ayrton Senna and was also the first number he used in single-seaters, in Formula 4. Another nice detail is that Antonelli is also the first driver since Senna in 1988 to clinch the F1 world title with the number 12. Beyond this special meaning, Antonelli has a second reason for keeping number 12, one that reflects who he is as a person. “It's also a way for me to stay grounded, to stay humble. I feel like keeping number 12 allows me to have a new point where to start and to build on everything again and try to improve more.” His modesty has proved to be an important quality on several occasions this year. Even after his impressive performance in Austin, when asked by this website how he manages to cope so well with the pressure at such a young age, Antonelli was particularly keen to give credit to his family and the people at Mercedes instead of himself. Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes Besides the value he attaches to number 12, Antonelli indicated that he has not had good experiences with the number 1, providing another reason not to make the switch. “To be honest, I'm very superstitious and number one has never been a good number for me. Whenever I put it [on], it went extremely badly!” Antonelli laughed. “So that’s one more reason to stay with number 12.” That superstition also played a role for Antonelli during the race weekend in Mexico, as he revealed in the post-race press conference. It meant he absolutely did not want to think the title was already in the bag, as he feared he might jinx the outcome. “I kept hearing the same thing over and over again”, Antonelli said, referring, according to Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff, to the fact that many people had already congratulated him prematurely on winning the world title on Friday. “And, you know, I'm quite straightforward on this: until it's done, it's not done. So, I knew that I still wanted to finish the job well, and it's not easy when you keep hearing from many people, guests, fans, congratulations for the championship. “Knowing myself, I'm very superstitious. And I'm telling you, it's not easy for me, especially being that superstitious!” Read Also: Kimi Antonelli wants special photo with Lewis Hamilton and Max Verstappen on his wall after F1

item.title: James Milner stuns fans with incredible New York Marathon time as Liverpool & Man City icon proves he is still a fitness machine at 40
item.description: Alfred Dunhill Links Championship - Previews - Getty Images Sport James Milner has long been regarded as one of the most dedicated professionals in the history of the Premier League, and he has now proven that his legendary engine is still running at full throttle. The former England international took on the gruelling New York Marathon this weekend, delivering a highly impressive performance on his debut over the 42.125-kilometre distance. Former midfielder shines in New York After calling time on his extensive two-decade football career this summer , Milner tested his renowned fitness levels on the famous New York course. The 40-year-old crossed the finish line with an impressive time of three hours, nine minutes, and four seconds. Tackling a route known more for testing hills than rapid finishes, the former Brighton and Aston Villa man recorded an average pace of seven minutes and 12 seconds per mile, which equates to roughly four minutes and 28 seconds per kilometre. Staying true to his pre-race strategy, Milner started aggressively instead of running a measured race. He cleared the first half in one hour and 31 minutes before battling through the latter stages to complete the second half in one hour and 38 minutes. Knee issues nearly scuppered running ambitions Ahead of his first world major, Milner admitted that his primary obstacle was "building up the mileage without getting injured", especially since his previous clubs had restricted his running workload late in his career. The Englishman also acknowledged that a faster time might have been possible in his younger days. "A few years ago, I feel like I could have definitely done sub-3:00," he explained. "My career went on longer and longer. Two years ago, I had a knee operation, and when I woke up from the knee operation, I couldn’t lift my foot. And I had a second operation that day to check, and then I couldn’t lift my foot for six months. I had nerve damage. "So I feel to go from not being able to walk properly and maybe never being able to walk to coming back, playing football in the Premier League, and hopefully potentially finishing a marathon, I don’t want to get too much caught up on the time." Premier League pedigree translates to the road Milner's seamless transition to long-distance running will surprise very few. During his time at Liverpool, he was famous for dominating the club's gruelling pre-season lactate threshold sessions, consistently outlasting his team-mates until they collapsed from exhaustion. He also possessed a strong childhood background in cross-country running. While his debut time is excellent, he sits slightly behind fellow former professionals in the marathon standings. Bayern Munich legend Arjen Robben and ex-Arsenal star Aaron Ramsey have both broken the three-hour barrier in Rotterdam and Stockholm, respectively, but both players also needed more than three hours during their first attempts. Elite class remains a step above Despite his outstanding effort

item.title: 'That’s not a penalty' - Jose Mourinho slams VAR inconsistency after Real Madrid spot-kick controversy
item.description: Real Racing Club de Santander v Real Madrid - LaLiga EA Sports 2026/27 - Getty Images Sport Real Madrid secured a comfortable 3-0 victory over Racing Santander, but the match was heavily overshadowed by a controversial penalty decision involving Kylian Mbappe. Jose Mourinho and former referee Eduardo Iturralde Gonzalez have both heavily criticised the lack of VAR intervention during the incident. Real Madrid cruise to victory Madrid secured a comfortable 3-0 victory over Racing Santander at El Sardinero. However, the comprehensive away win was overshadowed by a highly controversial penalty decision involving Mbappe. A spot-kick was awarded following an incident involving the French forward. The decision immediately sparked debate, with critics questioning the legitimacy of the foul and the glaring lack of intervention from the video assistant referee. Mourinho questions VAR decision Mourinho was quick to offer his assessment of the controversial incident. The manager revealed he reviewed the footage on a tablet and immediately felt a clear error had been made by the officials. "They change them so much, and the small details are such that people don’t know that it’s never a penalty by [Aurelien] Tchouameni because of the rebound from the ball," Mourinho explained on the club's official website . "It’s never a penalty. When the referee called a penalty, I stayed calm because from 60 meters away, I couldn’t see it. But later, when I saw it on the iPad, I thought, if VAR doesn’t mess up, that’s not a penalty. "For me, the referee was technically very good and disciplined. He gave out a couple of yellow cards, and that’s it. It was a tough and competitive match. For me, it’s obvious that it wasn’t a penalty." Ex-referee demands more consistency Former referee Gonzalez completely agreed with Mourinho's damning assessment. He strongly criticised the lack of consistency from the VAR officials, comparing the incident to a similar situation in the match between Getafe and Sevilla earlier in the day. "If the VAR has intervened in Getafe-Sevilla for a hand to the face, it has to intervene for this; otherwise, there is no refereeing consistency," Iturralde Gonzalez argued, as quoted by Mundo Deportivo . He was left baffled by the differing standards applied across the two matches in such a short space of time. He concluded: "Why in one hour has it intervened in Getafe and not in Santander in a very, very similar action? For me, it is not a penalty." Focus on the upcoming matches The controversial penalty ultimately helped Madrid secure all three points on their travels. Los Blancos will now switch their focus to their upcoming domestic and European fixtures. Mourinho’s side will travel to face AEK in the Champions League on Wednesday, followed by a clash against Valencia over the weekend.

item.title: Régis Le Bris gets official Sunderland vote of confidence to keep on doing great job
item.description: Regis le Bris arms folded It has now been revealed that Régis Le Bris has been told by Sunderland he has their full support and will continue in the job. It looked like the writing was on the wall when rock bottom Sunderland were outplayed and outclassed by second bottom Coventry City on Saturday, lucky to only lose 3-1. The Sky Blues now four points clear of hapless Sunderland. However, Sky Sports report that they have had official confirmation that Régis Le Bris has been informed his job is safe. Keith Downie covers Sunderland and Newcastle United for Sky Sports and he states: “Régis Le Bris’ position as Sunderland Head Coach is safe and he continues to have the full support and confidence of Sunderland’s hierarchy. The Frenchman remains central to Sunderland plans and ambitions, despite the club sitting bottom of the Premier League table. The belief within the club is the 50-year-old will turn things around.” Sunderland have lost five and drawn one of their last six Premier League matches and their late (no) consolation goal on Saturday came after more than six hours of league football without scoring. Sunderland have now picked up only two points from their last possible 21 and their only Premier League victory over the season was back in August, a lucky late 1-0 home win over Fulham. The man from Sky Sports adding about what they have heard from inside Sunderland AFC: “ There is an internal recognition that recent Premier League results have been disappointing and the club understand current frustrations felt by supporters. The club believe stability, collective responsibility and a united approach is the way forward for Sunderland as they look to achieve their ambitions….” Yes, Régis Le Bris is doing a great job at Sunderland and hopefully they will keep faith with him as they continue to lose many more matches. After losing so convincingly to the club that was second bottom, in the Premier League Sunderland now face Chelsea (home), Aston Villa (away), Spurs (home) and Liverpool (away). Before then heading to St James’ Park on Sunday 6 December to face Newcastle United . Whether Régis Le Bris will still have by that point the full backing of the Sunderland hierarchy remains to be seen… 🎙️ THE MAG PODCAST The Mag Pod Cover THE NEW MAG POD IS LIVE! item.title: Real Madrid captain returns to training ahead of AEK Athens clash
item.description: Real Madrid captain returns to training ahead of AEK Athens clash Real Madrid have received a timely boost after confirming on their website that Federico Valverde has returned to training with the first-team squad ahead of their upcoming fixture against AEK Athens. The midfielder missed the 3-0 victory over Racing Santander after experiencing discomfort during the Clasico against Barcelona, but his return to group training offers Jose Mourinho an important option during a demanding period. With Real Madrid facing multiple matches before the November international break, Valverde’s recovery could prove particularly valuable as the manager looks to maintain his team’s momentum without placing unnecessary strain on key players. Valverde returns after missing Racing Santander match Valverde experienced discomfort during the first half of Real Madrid’s victory over Barcelona and eventually came off in the second period. Although initial assessments ruled out a serious injury , the Uruguayan was unable to resume normal training with his teammates ahead of the Racing Santander fixture. Valverde has returned to team training. (Photo by Angel Martinez/Getty Images) There had been optimism that the captain would recover in time for Sunday’s match, but the coaching staff ultimately decided against risking him. His absence was noticeable given his importance to Mourinho’s midfield, although Real Madrid still secured a convincing 3-0 victory at El Sardinero. His return to group training therefore is an encouraging development ahead of Wednesday’s European assignment. However, completing a training session with the squad does not automatically guarantee that he will be ready to start. Mourinho receives boost before AEK Athens test Real Madrid travel to face AEK Athens in the UEFA Champions League on Wednesday, November 4, and Valverde’s availability would give Mourinho greater flexibility when selecting his midfield. Valverde missed the Racing game. (Photo by Angel Martinez/Getty Images) The manager may nevertheless consider managing the Uruguayan’s workload carefully, particularly after the discomfort he experienced against Barcelona. With an important fixture against Valencia scheduled next, there is little incentive to rush him back if he is not fully comfortable. Notably, Valverde has been operating as Mourinho’s preferred right-back in recent matches, but in his absence against Racing, Trent Alexander-Arnold played the full game. This means everything points to Denzel Dumfries starting the match against AEK Athens, potentially leaving Valverde to come on if the game requires.

item.title: Mourinho’s Real Madrid earns praise from former star: ‘The team is more united’
item.description: Mourinho’s Real Madrid earns praise from former star: ‘The team is more united’ Real Madrid’s form is slowly but surely peaking, as every passing game sees the team play one notch higher than the previous one. Their biggest result so far, quite clearly, was the win over Barcelona last weekend. A brace by Kylian Mbappe saw Los Blancos take all three points from the Spotify Camp Nou, and the big question was whether the team could keep the momentum going. Last evening, they returned to the field against Racing Club away from home and racked up another dominant win . By the end of the first half, the result was already seemingly written in stone. Rafa Alkorta hails Mourinho’s Real Madrid Now, former player Rafa Alkorta has praised Real Madrid for their newfound stability and good run of form. He also highlighted key players and elements of Jose Mourinho’s working system. Alkorta had high praise for Jude Bellingham. (Photo by Juan Manuel Serrano Arce/Getty Images) The player first opened up about how it was refreshing to see Real Madrid dominate games from the get-go once again and how the team is now very organised. “It’s been a long time since I’ve seen Madrid dominate the opening 20 minutes like that. Everyone is in their position, and everyone tracks back and does their defensive duties when required,” he said, as quoted by Defensa Central . He then specifically praised Jude Bellingham for the player that he is, and highlighted how he is a stellar goalscorer. “Bellingham is so good at making runs into the box. What a player! The way he attacks the far post is incredible.” The former player then spoke highly of Mourinho’s tactics and how the manager is not only playing to Real Madrid’s strengths but also capitalising on the opponents’ weaknesses. Mourinho’s side are slowly growing into an unstoppable side.(Photo by Juan Manuel Serrano Arce/Getty Images) “The most important thing, beyond what you do yourself, is what you prevent your opponent from doing. The team is more united, selfless and clear about what it wants to do. “It seems Mourinho has found his starting eleven, and at the same time, they’re neutralising their opponents.” “You improve your own game while limiting the opposition. Real Madrid had been missing that for a long time,” he added. Finally, the ex-player also spoke on the importance of man-management and substitutions in such games. “It was a game that was already under control. By the 60th minute, you should be making certain substitutions to manage the players’ workload.”

item.title: Liverpool fail to register a shot on target at Anfield for the first time in Premier League history
item.description: Liverpool fail to register a shot on target at Anfield for the first time in Premier League history Liverpool failed to land a single shot on target at Anfield as Arsenal ground out a 1-0 win, a first for the Reds at home in the Premier League era. Andoni Iraola 's side attempted 17 shots on Sunday, according to Sky Sports , yet David Raya never had to make a save. Kai Havertz's tap-in in the 16th minute proved decisive. Liverpool had never before played a Premier League match at Anfield without a shot on target, since the data was first collected in 2003/04. It came despite Andoni Iraola starting all of Liverpool's £100m+ recruits, as Alexander Isak, Florian Wirtz and Bradley Barcola featured from the start. The result handed Arsenal their first victory at Anfield since September 2012, a milestone Mikel Arteta celebrated after full-time, as the Spaniard hailed a 'historic' win . Woodwork, wayward headers and no penalty Liverpool's best moments came at the end of the first half. Florian Wirtz curled a free-kick onto the crossbar, and Alexis Mac Allister, unmarked, headed a Milos Kerkez cross over the bar. After the break Isak fired over from a tight angle, while Ronald Araujo had an effort blocked by Arsenal bodies. Substitute Victor Munoz got his head to a Kostas Tsimikas cross late on, which was the hosts' last chance. The biggest grievance was a first-half shirt pull by Jurrien Timber on Isak inside the box. The officials gave nothing, with both Iraola and Virgil van Dijk critical of the decision at full-time. Arsenal's chances were limited but cleaner. Alisson produced a fine stop to deny Christos Tzolis in the second half. By the closing stages, Liverpool were reduced to using Virgil van Dijk as an emergency centre-forward. The defeat was Liverpool's second under Iraola and ended a five-game winning run in all competitions. It leaves them fifth, nine points behind Arsenal, who sit three clear of Manchester City at the top. Iraola pointed to his side's slow start in his post-match briefing: "Overall, I think we have to blame especially the start of the game and until we conceded the goal."

item.title: Oleksandr Usyk talks up shock fight with feared champion at old weight
item.description: Oleksandr Usyk has talked up a showdown with feared cruiserweight champion David Benavidez , in a shocking potential next move. After surviving a scare against kickboxing icon Rico Verhoeven in the boxing ring in May, Usyk vacated the unified heavyweight titles and claimed his next bout would be his last. Now, however, the unbeaten Ukrainian has suggested he might have an extra fight in him, with the second of those two contests ideally coming against Benavidez. Oleksandr Usyk pictured in July (Getty) The Mexican-American is an undefeated three-weight champion , but his most-recent successes have come at cruiserweight, where he holds the WBA and WBO belts. Benavidez, 29, picked up the titles by dominating and stopping Gilberto “Zurdo” Ramirez in six rounds in May, having taken apart Anthony Yarde at light-heavyweight in his previous bout . Usyk is a two-time undisputed heavyweight champion, but he made his name at cruiserweight, where he became the only undisputed champion of the four-belt era. The 39-year-old was expected to round out his career at heavyweight, potentially against former champion Deontay Wilder , but he seems adamant about a surprising weight-cut to his old division. “Because I cleaned out the heavyweight [division] and [want to go] back to my weight,” Usyk told The Ring on Saturday. “Yes, correct, [I want to fight the best version of Benavidez]. “Right now, I weigh 96 or 97 kg [211-213lb]. If I have an opportunity at cruiserweight, I am back. It’s a big fight because Benavidez is a big champion. Me, a little bit, too?” Also at the weekend, Usyk’s team director Sergey Lapin told Casinostugan : “First, we are looking at a fight for a vacant world title. Then, the goal is to face David Benavidez to unify all the belts and become undisputed cruiserweight champion. David Benavidez dismantled Gilberto Ramirez in stunning fashion in May (Getty) “We see 2027 as the final chapter of his career. He wants to finish as undisputed champion in the division where he first won all the belts. If we’re going to do this, we need to take a comprehensive approach. The first fight for a world title, the second for the undisputed championship. “Usyk has never been a natural heavyweight; cruiserweight is his home. He loves a challenge, so he moved up, cleaned out the heavyweight division, and now he is coming home to restore order.” While Benavidez holds the WBA and WBO straps, Michal Cieslak owns the WBC title and will box the “Mexican Monster” in a unification fight in December . Meanwhile, the IBF title remains vacant after Jai Opetaia was stripped of the gold . Rico Verhoeven protesting the stoppage of his fight with Usyk (Getty) Usyk’s heavyweight-title fight with Verhoeven, at the pyramids of Giza in Egypt, proved highly controversial. The kickboxer was seemingly on track for a decision win when he was dropped and stopped in round 11, but the stoppage – which was widely deemed premature – was not the only controversy; the official scorecards wer

item.title: Big 12 football rushing yards, touchdown leaders after Week 9
item.description: West Virginia's Cam Cook has led the Big 12 in rushing yards for most of the season. However, with the Mountaineers on bye, Iowa State 's Aiden Flora took over after his 221-yard performance against Oklahoma State over the weekend. He also had two rushing touchdowns, including a 75-yard touchdown run in the fourth quarter. However, that shouldn't take away from Oklahoma State's running back, Caleb Hawkins. Hawkins also had a career day, logging 194 rushing yards and two touchdowns, including a 75-yard touchdown run in the third quarter. Texas Tech's running back, J'Koby Williams, also had a strong day with 175 rushing yards and a touchdown. His quarterback, Tommy Castellanos, also threw for over 100 yards. Cardae Mack of Arizona State also had a big day, rushing for 123 yards. item.title: Mutfwang vows to protect every inch of Plateau land
item.description: By Golok Nanmwa, Jos Plateau State Governor, Caleb Mutfwang, has vowed to protect every inch of the state’s territory, assuring residents that his administration will intensify security efforts and facilitate the return of internally displaced persons (IDPs) to their ancestral communities. Mutfwang gave the assurance on Monday in Jos during the formal inauguration of the All Progressives Congress (APC) Campaign Council, where he also called on party members to intensify grassroots mobilisation ahead of the 2027 general elections. The governor said his administration remained committed to protecting communities and preventing further displacement, adding that efforts were underway to strengthen security operations across the state. “If the people of Plateau knew the magnitude of the damage planned against our state, they would appreciate that only God’s intervention and our strategic efforts have helped us thus far. “One thing I have committed myself to is that I will ensure the protection of every inch of land in Plateau State. “Very soon, we are going to be taking practical steps to facilitate the return of internally displaced persons back to their communities,” he said. Mutfwang disclosed that his administration would deploy additional security personnel, announcing plans to commission a new batch of retrained Operation Rainbow operatives the following week. He added that at least 800 trained forest guards would also be deployed within four weeks as part of efforts to strengthen security across the state. “One of the things we have waited for is to get more boots on ground and, by the grace of God, next week we are going to commission a new batch of retrained Operation Rainbow operatives. “And in another four weeks, we are going to also release at least 800 trained forest guards. “We are determined to ensure that our people return to their ancestral homes,” the governor said. He commended President Bola Tinubu for what he described as his commitment to the welfare of Nigerians and support for efforts to address insecurity. Mutfwang appealed to residents to remain patient and trust his administration, assuring them that it would continue to work towards restoring peace and security. “And so, all we are asking Plateau people is, trust us, be patient with us, and by the grace of God, you will not regret it,” he said. On the 2027 elections, the governor urged members of the campaign council to take the APC’s message to communities across the state, saying his administration needed another mandate to complete ongoing projects and programmes. He said the campaign would seek the people’s endorsement for a second term to sustain the administration’s development agenda. “We are going to the nooks and crannies of Plateau State to solicit their endorsement and approval for a second time in office because the many things we have begun must not be aborted. “We must ensure that we bring things to a very glorious height,” he said.
